title: 🔮 Quick weekend reads: the big AI questions
text: 🔮 Quick weekend reads: the big AI questions Exponential View Subscribe Sign in 🔮 Quick weekend reads: the big AI questions A short set of readings on some of the biggest questions. Azeem Azhar Oct 03, 2026 ∙ Paid 62 5 2 Share AI is really forcing some big questions into the open. Here are some weekend reads on them. The biggest idea The Economist address the effective altruism (EA) belief system, which it calls “t his century’s biggest idea ”: [P]lenty of EAs in Silicon Valley think that only they can be trusted with the technology. That is an alarming idea. Effective altruists’ argument for worrying about really powerful AIs is that the machines could optimise for a single and fatally wrong objective. Everyone should worry, too, about what happens when a small group of people fall into the same trap The full analysis is worth reading . Also read the brief response by Alexander Berger, the CEO of Coefficient Giving, an EA-aligned philanthropist. The religious angle The New York Times reports that Anthropic had been consulting with religious scholars and theologians on the question of machine consciousness.
